title: My COB calculated some problems. It made me inject a lot of SMB.
symptom: The user reports that their COB (carbs on board) calculation had problems, leading to a lot of SMB (super micro bolus) injections, potentially causing low blood sugar. They deleted a record at 9 PM to avoid low blood sugar.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the maintainer acknowledges a bug and says it is fixed in a commit, implying a bug in COB calculation.
fix: The maintainer states it is fixed in a commit and that a new release will cover the issue. No specific workaround is given.
evidence_quote: Great catch. Thanks. Fixed in https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/d1bad3c55323d4e057e0f71080f11623b4217e49 All AAPS 3.x versions are affected I'll do new release covering this issue
